dependencies.name: git
dependencies.purpose: Installs and verifies the pinned Rhize Outreach runtime checkout.
dependencies.degradedBehavior: Setup cannot install or verify the outreach runtime.

replacement.suggestion: Install Xcode Command Line Tools or Git for Mac.
replacement.warning: There is no supported runtime installation path without Git.

dependencies.name: node
dependencies.purpose: Runs the TypeScript outreach runtime and its local review interface.
dependencies.degradedBehavior: Campaign execution and the review UI are unavailable.

replacement.warning: Older Node versions are outside the runtime's supported engine range.

dependencies.name: macOS Keychain
dependencies.purpose: Stores operator-entered Supabase and connector secrets outside plugin configuration.
dependencies.degradedBehavior: The supported setup wizard cannot persist secrets safely.

replacement.suggestion: Run the plugin on a Rhize-managed Mac.
replacement.warning: Plaintext files and chat messages are not supported secret-storage replacements.

dependencies.name: rhize-outreach runtime
